## Session Start

- Run `/ea-open` at the start of every session to load engagement context and the next-action menu. Do not proceed without it unless the user explicitly says to skip.

## Artifacts

- Read an artifact's full frontmatter before modifying it.
- Never modify an artifact with `reviewStatus: Approved` without warning the user first and confirming intent.
- Strategic intent (goals, objectives, strategies, drivers, issues) lives in `engagement.json → direction` and artifact files. Do not copy it into CLAUDE.md or other generated files.

## Concepts and References

- EA concept definitions (Goal, Objective, Strategy, Issue, Problem, Driver, etc.) are the single source of truth in `skills/ea-artifact-templates/references/ea-concepts.md`. Do not redefine or paraphrase them inline.
- TOGAF phase guidance lives in `skills/ea-engagement-lifecycle/references/adm-phase-guide.md`. Do not summarise ADM phases from memory — read the file.
- Artifact compliance rules (T1/T2/T3) live in `skills/ea-artifact-templates/references/compliance-check.md`.

## IDs

- Use the unified ID scheme: DRV-NNN, G-NNN, OBJ-NNN, STR-NNN, MET-NNN, ISS-NNN, PRB-NNN, RIS-NNN, ADR-NNN, REQ-NNN, WP-NNN, GAP-NNN, CON-NNN.
- Do not use domain-prefixed variants (BG-, DG-, AG-, TG-, BO-, etc.) — these are obsolete.

## UI

- Brainstorm and interview UIs are written as plain HTML files to `ui/` — never as React artifacts. Open via `file://` path.
